question: What substances must be avoided when worshipping the goddess?
premises: Worship of the goddess must not be done with uneatable things.
One should not cause indigo-red items to be offered.
inference: Uneatable substances and indigo-red offerings are prohibited in worship of the goddess.
uncertainties: The precise nature of nīlīraktaṃ as dye, cloth, or substance is unclear.
plain_english: One should not worship the goddess with uneatable things, nor cause indigo-red offerings to be given.
